api_evidence.finding: Verified both the opposite-face-dot sum degeneracy and radius-to-point-radius division by two against executed isolated targets.
Actual runtime creates GreasePencilLineartModifier using LINEART with the recorded properties.
Underscore corner attributes become glTF vertex attributes; actual exported GLB scalar values asserted.
Official binary and checksum list, verified before extraction.

execution_target: Local arm64 macOS; headless Blender EEVEE Next

runtime_configuration.raster_camera: Shared original matrixWorld and projectionMatrix; float32 Blender representation checked against float64 source for every triangle vertex
runtime_configuration.line_art_radius_note: API field is diameter in generated world units; point radius is half
runtime_configuration.source_faces: White emission; hidden only after genuine Line Art modifier is baked

stage_and_resources: Local scratch only; no hosted resources or paid APIs

inputs.source: Fresh three.js stand-in geometry export; no reference snapshot read or executed

procedure: Verified and extracted official Blender binary into local scratch; no system install.
Executed exact-camera nine-cell Line Art baseline and independently reproduced missing cylinder contour.
Recorded and applied classifier-only epsilon; rendered nine corrected targets using unchanged raster camera.
Verified all source triangle projections against float64 shared camera matrices.
Sampled local stroke width in each rung/DPR.
Independently authored three parametric stall variants in Python; compared shape and triangle counts; exported and parsed GLB custom attributes.
expected_result: Genuine Line Art ground-truth layer with identical geometry and orthographic camera; independent Blender parametric stall route with preserved Atlas attributes.
observed_result: Nine usable corrected Line Art targets produced, with explicit classification-camera deviation. Exact-camera baseline omits symmetric cylinder silhouettes and is preserved as failed target evidence. All 13,908 raster vertex projections agree within 0.000290 CSS pixels; local width is 1.0 CSS pixel in nine cells. Three independent stall variants exported with verified custom scalar attribute values.
